g.text: Collection naming, pivots, materials and export contract / build the physical route before decoration
For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
Site bounds, grid, FFL markers, origin empties
Union floors, explicit voids / tunnel shell
Shared concourses; H1 and H2 placed modules
ST-P and ST-H, mirrored with their instance
Door apertures, court fences and cover
Use one Blender unit = one metre. Site pivot is world centre at
(0,0,0). Module pivot is local minimum x/z at FFL. Apply transforms
and recalculate normals after mirroring; keep scale +1.0. Bake the
Export efficient render GLBs per spatial chunk. Preserve
module/instance IDs as custom properties. Keep physical geometry and
nav links in separate data. The existing WWB runtime uses one Rapier
world and one actor movement owner.
DONT SHIP THE GUIDE AS FINAL ART
The companion .blend is exact blockout guidance with solid colours
and labelled openings. It is separate from the old massing. Do not
overwrite manual work or bundle the research clones. Donor assets
shared neutral base + local streak masks
slab joints and dirty drain edges
beds and seams; alpha overdraw budget
1. Structural silhouette and openings. 2. Recessed frames, parapets and soffits. 3. Shared PBR
materials with consistent scale. 4. Dirt/wetness masks placed by water and use. 5. Instanced
vegetation and rubbish. 6. Local lighting rebuilt and measured in Three.js.
Drain slots, joints, moss and leaf litter follow edges. Kerbs stay outside primary walk polygons. Use flush
transitions where the designed route crosses a change of material. Detail heights are render intent until
Walk every home exit and every stair both directions with actual
capsules. Verify floor-aware bot routes at overlapping x/z, no
double floors, correct roof closures, reliable headroom and no spawn
sightlines. Then compare a camera view to the original London
Measure frame time, memory and load with populated actors on a real
GPU. Route checks and these drawings do not prove game balance or
server capacity. Networking is a separate later milestone.
